brief.zh: 安全值班收到正常变更和混合登录日志。关联同一用户短时间内的失败与成功、核对批准设备，交出命中、误报、漏报和需二线补查的证据。
brief.en: An analyst receives mixed login events and an approved-device list. Correlate short failure bursts with subsequent success and quantify false alarms and misses.

zh: 查询、事件链与命中清单
误漏报、建议处置和复盘交接
en: false positives and an escalation handoff

zh: 查询输出与指定标签/事件ID对照
时间与主机/用户关联规则一致
en: Reconcile the complete result with the supplied input IDs and values.
Marking every successful login suspicious produces false positives. This is a blocking regression.

failure.zh: 全部事件都报异常以换取命中率，应在误报/范围检查中暴露
failure.en: Marking every successful login suspicious produces false positives.

en: Locate the decision and supporting input/result in your deliverables.
Explain remaining uncertainty, your contribution and what the receiving role must verify.

environment.scope: Original small deterministic teaching application; no real enterprise traffic or model inference
